lastResponse.text: That’s a fair ask. I don’t want to guess about attached data. From what I can confirm, two one one info has a privacy policy and data-use terms, so you can request a minimal-data referral first. You can say: “Before you refer me, please list exactly what you’ll send: my name, phone, location, notes, documents, and call recording and transcript status. I only consent to the minimum needed.” If you want, I can draft a shorter text or voicemail version.
